zoe: quick flag - Cost dashboard showing weirdly large cache credits for sessions that switch model mid-stream. sample below where amortized credit exceeds actual pre-warm usage.

omar: can you paste the sample? curious if session rejoin or sticky routing is causing double counting at aggregation.

zoe: sample: session_id=ss77, initial_cache_warm=150, total_tokens=200, later switched to smaller-model for last 80 tokens. dashboard applied full warm credit across 200 tokens.

ben: root cause likely aggregation stage: we tag session with `cache_warm` at start and later reconciler sums per-session credits without slicing by executed token spans.

pm-lee: UX asks: show "reconciliation status" and a small "sampling confidence" pct on the tenant card; also add an action to reveal raw span events for support.

omar: engineering options: a) router emits compact span-marker events (session_span with token_start, token_end, model_id, cache_warm_amount) into event bus; b) keep router minimal and have the sidecar emit spans based on observed chunks. I prefer explicit span events.

ben: minimal product change: accept span events + a reconciliation job that prorates cache credits by token span. fallback: if no spans, estimate split via timestamp + avg tokens/sec and mark as "estimated".

zoe: agree. console change: show provisional numbers dotted, reconciled numbers solid, tooltip with "est. error: +/-5% (heuristic)".

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for span-event-emitter -> 2/4 hosts updated :rocket:

omar: i'll prototype span emitter today, indexer + billing join tomorrow. ben will take console bits. leave FF off until nightly reconcile validated.

zoe: I'll add an integration vector with non-aligned span boundaries (handoff inside a chunk) to ensure prorating works. closing once tests and FF are ready.
